newsitem.title: UK: Mercury nets multi-mln stg UUNET dial-up deal.
newsitem.headline: Mercury nets multi-mln stg UUNET dial-up deal.

text.p: UK telecommunications operator Mercury Communications, part of the Cable & Wireless group of companies, said on Tuesday it had won a multi-million pound supply deal from giant Internet access provider UUNET PIPEX.
As part of the deal, Mercury will supply the group with 3,000 of its NetLink lines for its dial-up service in the UK, enabling UUNET PIPEX to connect more dial-up customers at local rates.
It is also supplying the company with a 45-Megabit-per- second bandwidth for the U.S. which will provide customers with guaranteed connection to sites on the Internet worldwide web.

"This contract with UUNET PIPEX represents a significant win for Mercury, establishing us as a key supplier to Internet service providers in the UK," said Eamonn Dullaghan, Mercury's commercial manager in the Internet provider market.
